entries.title: The father rides; the son, a little
entries.literal_meaning: Whose father rides a horse, that son rides a little.
entries.explanation: The rhyme moves from a father’s riding to a smaller amount in the son’s clause. The dictionary quotes it under “slightly; a little.” Our reading notices the partial echo between generations, without turning it into a law of inheritance. The line does not explain how either person learned, measure their skill, or establish that every child repeats a parent’s occupation.
entries.meaning_odia: ବାପଙ୍କ ଘୋଡ଼ା ଚଢ଼ିବାରୁ ପୁଅଙ୍କ ଖଣ୍ଡରେ ଅଳ୍ପ ପରିମାଣକୁ ଛନ୍ଦ ଯାଏ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଏହା ସାମାନ୍ୟରେ ବା ଈଷତ ଅର୍ଥ ତଳେ ଅଛି। ଆମ ପାଠ ପିଢ଼ି ମଧ୍ୟରେ ଆଂଶିକ ପ୍ରତିଧ୍ୱନି ଦେଖେ, ବଂଶଗତ ନିୟମ ନୁହେଁ। କିଏ କିପରି ଶିଖିଲେ, କାହାର ଦକ୍ଷତା କେତେ, ବା ସବୁ ପିଲା ବାପମାଆଙ୍କ ପେଶା ନିଅନ୍ତି କି ନାହିଁ—ଧାଡ଼ିଟି ତାହା ପ୍ରମାଣ କରେନାହିଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading hears a small repetition, not an inherited destiny.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ଅଳ୍ପ ପୁନରାବୃତ୍ତି ଶୁଣେ, ବଂଶଗତ ଭାଗ୍ୟ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ବାପଙ୍କ ସହ କାମ ଦେଖିଥିବା ପୁଅଟି ନିଜେ ଗୋଟିଏ ଛୋଟ କାମ ଶିଖିଲା। ତାଙ୍କ ଅନ୍ୟ ପସନ୍ଦକୁ ମଧ୍ୟ ପରିବାର ସ୍ଥାନ ଦେଲା। / A child learns one small task while retaining other interests. This scene is invented.
entries.cultural_context: The quotation’s father and son remain intact, without an added biological or caste claim. The earlier Radhanath Darbar verse illustrates a different sense and is not this saying’s authorship.

entries.title: Neither doing it nor making way
entries.literal_meaning: Provisional reading: that person neither shits nor makes way.
entries.explanation: The blunt bodily image pairs not doing something with not letting another pass. The dictionary supplies making room for another as the relevant sense of leaving the way. Our reading applies the contrast to obstruction: someone neither proceeds nor clears space. This does not identify a real person’s health, intention or circumstances, and it is not advice about bodily functions.
entries.meaning_odia: ରୁକ୍ଷ ଶାରୀରିକ ଚିତ୍ରଟି ନିଜେ ନ କରିବା ସହ ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ବାଟ ନ ଛାଡ଼ିବାକୁ ଯୋଡ଼େ। ଅଭିଧାନରେ ଅନ୍ୟକୁ ଯିବାକୁ ଜାଗା ଦେବା ଅର୍ଥ ଅଛି। ଉତ୍ସର ହଗ ଶବ୍ଦରୂପ ଅବିକଳ ରଖି ଆମେ ଏହାର ସମ୍ଭାବ୍ୟ ପାଠ ଦେଉଛୁ। ଆମ ପ୍ରୟୋଗରେ କେହି ନିଜେ ଆଗେଇନାହାନ୍ତି କି ଜାଗା ମଧ୍ୟ ଛାଡ଼ୁନାହାନ୍ତି। ଏଥିରୁ ପ୍ରକୃତ ବ୍ୟକ୍ତିଙ୍କ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟ, ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ ବା ପରିସ୍ଥିତି ନିର୍ଣ୍ଣୟ ହୁଏନାହିଁ। ଏହା ଶରୀର ସମ୍ବନ୍ଧୀୟ ପରାମର୍ଶ ନୁହେଁ।
entries.english_summary: Our reading describes obstruction while keeping the coarse register visible.
entries.odia_summary: ଆମ ପାଠ ବାଧାକୁ ଦେଖାଏ, ରୁକ୍ଷ ଭାଷାକୁ ଲୁଚାଏନାହିଁ।
entries.usage_example: Original imagined example: ଯନ୍ତ୍ରଟି ବ୍ୟବହାର ନ କରି ଜଣେ ଧରି ରଖିଥିଲେ। ଦଳଟି ପାଳି ଠିକ୍ କରି ସମସ୍ତଙ୍କୁ କାମ କରିବା ଜାଗା ଦେଲା। / A group agrees turns for equipment left unused but occupied. This application is invented.
entries.cultural_context: Exact ହଗ is not silently repaired. Sense2 making way is distinct from taking a wrong path in sense1; gender and a particular bodily incident are not supplied.
